h:
展示中的所有视频/图像都包含元数据，因此您可以将它们拖/放到 ComfyUI 中以自动填充工作流程，而无需下载 zip/JSON。

一个简单的 HunYuan 工作流程，可与 ComfyUI 的原生 HunYuan 功能配合使用。

这是一个 2 阶段的工作流程。第一阶段是 480x272 低分辨率视频生成，第二阶段是升级/创意阶段，将其升级为 960x544 中分辨率视频，并根据您的去噪级别修复/更改内容。

您可以通过在大约 30-60 秒内运行工作流程的低分辨率部分来快速微调提示，具体取决于您的显卡。然后，当您找到喜欢的低分辨率视频时，您可以继续工作流程来升级它并获得更好的分辨率输出。

蓝色节点 - 更新这些节点以指向您可以从中下载的本地模型这里

绿色节点 - 根据您的喜好修改这些节点。节点旁边有注释，解释您的更改可能如何影响输出。

o.en:
All videos/images in the showcase have metadata in them, so you can drag/drop them into ComfyUI to autopopulate the workflow without needing to download the zip/JSON.

A simple HunYuan workflow that works with ComfyUI's native HunYuan functionality.

This is a 2-stage workflow. The first stage is 480x272 low-resolution video generation, and the second stage is an upscaling/creativity stage that will upscale it into a 960x544 mid-resolution video and fix/change things depending on your denoising level.

You can quickly fine-tune your prompts by running them through the low-resolution portion of the workflow in ~30-60s depending on your graphics card. Then when you find a low-resolution video you like, you can continue to workflow to upscale it and get a better resolution output.

Blue nodes - Update these to point to your local models that you can download fromhere

Green nodes - Modify these to your heart's content. There are notes next to nodes to explain how your changes may affect the output.
